text: The campaign of 1866, fortunate beyond precedent in its results, had made it possible to build up on the ruins of the old German Confederation a new German constitution which at any rate assured to the majority of the nation a unity which it had so long and so passionately striven to attain, and which at the same time offered a guarantee for the hopeful development, in the future, of a State organization which would comprise the whole nation.

ruins  of  the  old  German  Confederation  a  new  German

passionately  striven  to  attain,  and  which  at  the  same
time  offered  a  guarantee  for  the  hopeful  development,
in  the  future,  of  a  State  organization  which  would
comprise  the  whole  nation.

text: Gentlemen, the better our forces are organized on land and water, the more perfectly they are armed, the more ready they are for war, the sooner may we hope it may be to preserve peace a while longer, or it may be, on the other hand, to carry on an inevitable war with honour and success.

Gentlemen,  the  better  our  forces  are  organized  on
land  and  water,  the  more  perfectly  they  are  armed,
the  more  ready  they  are  for  war,  the  sooner  may  we
hope  it  may  be  to  preserve  peace  a  while  longer,  or
it  may  be,  on  the  other  hand,  to  carry  on  an  inevitable
war  with  honour  and  success.

text: Gentlemen, every Government, each in its own country, is confronted with the tasks of the very highest social moment — vital questions which war can postpone but which it cannot solve.

Gentlemen,  every  Government,  each  in  its  own
country,  is  confronted  with  the  tasks  of  the  very  highest
social  moment — vital  questions  which  war  can  postpone
but  which  it  cannot  solve.

text: I believe that all Govern- ments are honestly anxious to maintain peace ; the only question is whether they will be strong enough to do so.

ments are  honestly  anxious  to  maintain  peace  ;  the  only
question  is  whether  they  will  be  strong  enough  to  do  so.

placed  themselves  at  their  head.
